newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative MP faces new constituency skirmish.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative MP faces new constituency skirmish.

text.p: Right-wing Conservative member of parliament Sir George Gardiner faces a new showdown with party members in his constituency on Thursday evening after calling Prime Minister John Major "a ventriloquist's dummy".

But the confrontation is less serious for the party as a whole than the last one in June, when Gardiner threatened to resign as MP for Reigate in southern England if members voted against him as candidate for the next general election.
Gardiner's survival then prevented the government from losing its overall majority in parliament -- at least until last month when it lost a by-election elsewhere.
This time, Gardiner faces a vote of no confidence for the remark about Major, which he wrote in an article published in the Sunday Express newspaper.

If he loses, there could be a new vote on whether he should be de-selected as candidate for the prosperous stockbroker belt seat, which he won for the Conservatives with a 17,664 vote majority at the 1992 election. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
